slides.title: Nature and the Environment
bullets: Prepare to read, discuss and write
slides.narration: Welcome to Grade 3 English, Unit 7: Nature and the Environment. Unit 7 follows Amal, Nora and Teacher Yasmin from the coast to the forest and up a mountain trail. You will meet fifteen nature words, from climate and temperature to matter, energy and planet. You will use the present perfect to say what they have seen, explored and visited, ask “Have you ever…?” questions, and build describing phrases such as “a metal rock on the beach”. The unit closes with clear instructions and a short poem about caring for our planet. In this short lecture, preview the key ideas and prepare for the independent lesson.

slides.title: What you will achieve
bullets: Name and describe the beach, the coast, the forest and the mountain using unit vocabulary.
Explain the difference between weather, climate and temperature, and describe today's weather.
Form present perfect sentences with have or has and the correct past participle.
slides.narration: By the end of this unit, you will be able to name and describe the beach, the coast, the forest and the mountain using unit vocabulary. You will also explain the difference between weather, climate and temperature, and describe today's weather. You will also form present perfect sentences with have or has and the correct past participle. Keep these goals in mind as you work.

slides.title: Words to learn
slides.narration: Your vocabulary work begins with these words: climate, weather, temperature, sunshine, froze, mountain. Listen to each word, look at what it means, and try to use it when you talk and write.

slides.title: Read and think
bullets: Point to the words that show it
slides.narration: The reading sequence includes Our Wonderful Nature and A Poem: “Nature Is Our Home”. Read slowly, look at the pictures, and find the big idea in each text. When you answer a question, point to the words that show it.

slides.title: The Present Perfect Tense

Try it in your own sentences
slides.narration: The first language focus is The Present Perfect Tense. We use the present perfect for something that happened before but still matters today. When you say “I have explored a forest”, you tell people what your life has already included. Look at the examples, then try the pattern in your own sentences.

slides.title: Use English for a real purpose
bullets: Speaking 1 — Describe a Place in Nature
Writing 1 — Describe the Nature Near You
Say it, write it, make it better
slides.narration: In speaking, you will complete Speaking 1 — Describe a Place in Nature. Say your ideas clearly and listen to your partner. In writing, you will draw, trace, copy or write, then check your work with a grown-up or the AI tutor.

slides.title: You are ready to begin
bullets: Activities, quiz and optional live sessions
slides.narration: You are ready to begin. Start with the words, then the reading and the questions, then the grammar, speaking and writing. Ask the AI tutor for help any time, and bring your questions to a live session too if you join one.
